# redirhub Provider

Manage RedirHub domains and links (short links, QR codes, redirects and migration mappings) as code.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    redirhub = {
      source  = "redirhub/redirhub"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# The token comes from REDIRHUB_API_TOKEN; create one under Account → API tokens.
provider "redirhub" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) An API token from Account → API tokens. The token belongs to one workspace. Defaults to the REDIRHUB_API_TOKEN environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) The API base URL. Defaults to REDIRHUB_API_URL, or https://api.redirhub.com/v1.
- `workspace` (String) The workspace id, for a token that is not bound to a workspace. Defaults to REDIRHUB_WORKSPACE.
